identity.real_world_identity_notes: Volkswagen racing truck of the Brazilian Copa Truck championship, one of the manufacturers the series lists among its competitors.

wheel_rim.notes: Observed from the cockpit during the guided drive.

notes: Simulator behaviour was directly observed in a guided drive in AMS2 1.6.9.91 with automatic clutch and shifting disabled. There is no automatic cut or blip, so the driver lifts to upshift.

The gearbox is a five-speed plus a launch gear, and first is locked out: it cannot be selected to pull away, so the driver starts in second and races on the remaining five. A tester found first unavailable in normal running and thought it a fault, which is the lockout rather than a modelling error, and the six observed gears are that 5+1.

The regulations mandate a mechanically operated H-pattern manual gearbox but leave its design free, so the engagement type is not established and the downshift blip stays unknown rather than being inferred from racing practice.
Observed live in AMS2 1.6.9.91 via guided verification observation ams2.volkswagen-constellation.20260814t195049095z-dedbdeac by Jason Kinslow.

confidence.basis: Simulator behaviour was live-tested in AMS2 1.6.9.91 with automatic clutch and shifting disabled, and the real-world transmission is supported by registered sources.

claims.basis: Registered sources establish the championship and its mandated gearbox, and the exact simulator identity was observed live.

The championship regulations mandate a mechanically operated H-pattern manual gearbox, and the reference gives a 5-speed plus launch gear. The live drive selected six H-pattern gears, which is that 5+1. The guided drive found first locked out and pulled away in second, so the launch gear is not selectable in normal running.
Directly observed during the guided drive: move-off, shift clutch use, automatic cut and blip, and the cockpit rim.

driver_summary: Copa Truck regulations mandate a mechanically operated H-pattern manual: five racing gears plus a launch gear. First is locked out, so pull away in second. Whether it engages by dogs or synchros is not stated, so blip on downshifts to be safe.
